en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a metal truss bridge spanning a river landscape. In the foreground is a narrow canal or stream bordered by a curved stone embankment, leading the eye toward the main river and bridge in the middle distance. Trees and grassy banks surround the scene, and a couple of small human figures stand near the river. The sky is light blue with scattered clouds. Printed text in German appears at the top of the image.
